about: Every template of NetCyberAI Labs. Builders implement exactly this config shape, these targets and these events (labs/CONTRACT.md). Lab authors may only use what is listed here. <id> means one of the ids in the config. A template may accept extra optional config keys, but must accept this shape.

about.en: Pour, mix, heat and test: real reactions, indicators, pH and gases.
about.hi: डालो, मिलाओ, गर्म करो और जाँचो: असली अभिक्रियाएँ, सूचक, pH और गैसें।

templates.config: { items: [substance id ×1–6], start?: [substance id], tools?: ['lamp'|'ph'|'electrolysis'|'limewater'|'splint'], hideEq?: boolean (true hides the balanced equation in the result card, for labs met before balancing is taught) }. The template's own substance list (zinc, hcl, pbno3, ki, cuso4, feso4, nail, copperwire, cao, water, soda, vinegar, naoh, bluelitmus, redlitmus, phenol, …) is extended by the builder to cover school chemistry: magnesium, sodium carbonate, lime water, ferrous sulphate crystals, silver chloride, salt solution, sugar, lemon juice, soap solution, universal indicator, turmeric, china rose, copper oxide, iron filings, sulphur, starch solution, iodine, alcohol, ethanoic acid, Benedict's-free biology tests (starch-iodine), milk, egg white, chalk, ammonium chloride, etc. Unknown ids fail validate().
templates.notes: Every reaction from a checked table; indicators by acid/base/neutral rule; pH meter shows the substance's real pH band; gas tests: hydrogen pops, oxygen relights a glowing splint, CO2 turns lime water milky. Spirit lamp heating for thermal decomposition and water of crystallisation; electrolysis of water gives 2:1 hydrogen:oxygen.

about.en: See the particles inside solids, liquids and gases; heat, dissolve, diffuse and separate mixtures.
about.hi: ठोस, द्रव और गैस के अंदर के कण देखो; गर्म करो, घोलो, फैलाओ और मिश्रण अलग करो।

templates.config: { mode: 'states'|'dissolve'|'diffusion'|'separate'|'gaslaw', substance?: 'water'|'wax'|'salt'|'sugar'|'ink'|'perfume'|'air', method?: 'filter'|'evaporate'|'distil'|'decant'|'magnet'|'sieve'|'chromatography'|'centrifuge'|'sublimation', mixture?: string id from the template's list }
templates.notes: Particle motion speed from temperature; melting and boiling points of the chosen substance true; gas law mode keeps PV/T consistent.

about.en: Build atoms from protons, neutrons and electrons; shells, valency, isotopes and the periodic table.
about.hi: प्रोटॉन, न्यूट्रॉन और इलेक्ट्रॉन से परमाणु बनाओ; कोश, संयोजकता, समस्थानिक और आवर्त सारणी।

templates.subjects: science 9, chemistry 11 (structure of atom, periodic table), physics 12 (atoms, nuclei)
templates.config: { mode: 'build'|'shells'|'isotopes'|'table'|'models', target?: element symbol (H to Ca for build/shells; any for table), show?: ['charge','mass','valency','config'] }
templates.notes: Element identity from proton count; shells 2,8,8 for Z ≤ 20; Rutherford scattering animation; periodic trends from real data.

about.en: Join atoms by sharing or giving electrons; see shapes, name carbon compounds.
about.hi: इलेक्ट्रॉन साझा करके या देकर परमाणु जोड़ो; आकार देखो, कार्बन यौगिकों के नाम बनाओ।

templates.config: { mode: 'covalent'|'ionic'|'carbon'|'shapes'|'isomers', target?: formula or name the child should build (e.g. 'CH4','C2H4','NaCl','MgCl2','ethanol'), atoms?: ['C','H','O','N','Cl','Na','Mg'] }
templates.notes: Valency rules enforced; IUPAC names for alkanes, alkenes, alkynes up to C6 and the NCERT functional groups; VSEPR shapes for the NCERT list.

about.en: Tap elements, see trends in size, metallic character and valency.
about.hi: तत्वों पर टैप करो, आकार, धात्विक गुण और संयोजकता के रुझान देखो।

templates.config: { highlight?: 'groups'|'periods'|'metals'|'blocks'|'trend:size'|'trend:metallic'|'trend:electronegativity'|'trend:ionisation', focus?: [symbols], history?: 'dobereiner'|'newlands'|'mendeleev'|'modern' }
templates.notes: Real data for Z 1–54 at least; Döbereiner triads and Newlands octaves shown truthfully.

about.en: Mirrors, lenses, glass slabs and prisms; rays and images from the real formulas.
about.hi: दर्पण, लेंस, काँच की पट्टी और प्रिज़्म; असली सूत्रों से किरणें और प्रतिबिंब।

templates.subjects: science 6–10, physics 12 (ray and wave optics), evs 5
templates.config: { element: 'plane'|'concave-mirror'|'convex-mirror'|'convex-lens'|'concave-lens'|'slab'|'prism'|'eye'|'combination'|'pinhole'|'shadow', f?: cm (5–40), n?: refractive index (1.0–2.5), object?: cm from the element, eye?: 'normal'|'myopia'|'hypermetropia', corrective?: boolean, white_light?: boolean }
templates.notes: Mirror and lens formulas with the NCERT sign convention; Snell's law; total internal reflection at the critical angle; dispersion order VIBGYOR; eye accommodation range 25 cm to infinity.

about.en: Build circuits with cells, bulbs, resistors, switches and meters; Ohm's law, series, parallel, power and house wiring.
about.hi: सेल, बल्ब, प्रतिरोध, स्विच और मीटर से परिपथ बनाओ; ओम का नियम, श्रेणी, समांतर, शक्ति और घर की वायरिंग।

templates.config: { mode: 'free'|'ohm'|'series-parallel'|'resistivity'|'power'|'house'|'conductors'|'kirchhoff'|'wheatstone'|'diode'|'logic', parts?: ['cell','battery','bulb','resistor','switch','ammeter','voltmeter','rheostat','fuse','led','diode','wire:<material>'], preset?: string id of a starting layout }
templates.notes: Readings from Ohm's law and Kirchhoff's rules; resistance from ρl/A with real resistivities; bulbs' brightness from power; fuse melts above rating; house mode with live, neutral, earth, MCB.

about.en: Magnetic and electric fields: magnets, compasses, current-carrying wires, coils, motors, induction and charges.
about.hi: चुंबकीय और विद्युत क्षेत्र: चुंबक, कंपास, धारावाही तार, कुंडली, मोटर, प्रेरण और आवेश।

templates.subjects: science 6, 8, 10, physics 12 (charges, fields, magnetism, EMI, AC)
templates.config: { source: 'bar-magnet'|'two-magnets'|'wire'|'loop'|'solenoid'|'force-on-wire'|'motor'|'induction'|'charges'|'earth', show?: 'filings'|'compass'|'lines'|'vectors', charges?: [{q: -3..3, x, y}] }
templates.notes: Right-hand thumb rule and Fleming's left-hand rule directions correct; induced current only while flux changes; Coulomb's law for charges.

about.en: Make things move and see distance, speed, velocity and acceleration as numbers and graphs.
about.hi: चीज़ों को चलाओ और दूरी, चाल, वेग और त्वरण को संख्याओं और ग्राफ़ में देखो।

templates.subjects: science 7–9, physics 11 (kinematics, projectile, circular motion), maths 9–11 (graphs)
templates.config: { mode: '1d'|'graph-match'|'free-fall'|'projectile'|'circular'|'relative', vehicle?: 'car'|'cycle'|'ball'|'train'|'auto', u?: m/s, a?: m/s², angle?: degrees, g?: 9.8 }
templates.notes: Equations of motion exact; graphs drawn from the same data; projectile range and height exact; no air resistance unless stated.

about.en: Push, pull, friction, pressure, floating, levers, pulleys and Newton's laws.
about.hi: धक्का, खिंचाव, घर्षण, दाब, तैरना, उत्तोलक, घिरनी और न्यूटन के नियम।

templates.subjects: science 6–9, physics 11 (laws of motion, work-energy, rotation, gravitation, fluids), evs 4–5
templates.config: { mode: 'push'|'friction'|'newton2'|'collision'|'pressure'|'buoyancy'|'lever'|'pulley'|'inclined'|'energy'|'gravity'|'spring', surface?: 'ice'|'glass'|'wood'|'carpet'|'sand', object?: string, mass?: kg, fluid?: 'water'|'salt-water'|'oil' }
templates.notes: F = ma; friction coefficients per surface; Archimedes' principle with real densities; lever and pulley mechanical advantage exact; momentum and energy conserved where they should be.

about.en: Make waves and sounds; pitch, loudness, echoes, strings, pipes and interference.
about.hi: तरंगें और ध्वनि बनाओ; तारत्व, प्रबलता, प्रतिध्वनि, तार, नलियाँ और व्यतिकरण।

templates.subjects: science 8–9 (sound), physics 11 (waves, oscillations), physics 12 (wave optics, EM waves)
templates.config: { mode: 'vibrate'|'string'|'pipe'|'echo'|'spring'|'pendulum'|'shm'|'interference'|'diffraction'|'spectrum', medium?: 'air'|'water'|'steel', play_sound?: boolean }
templates.notes: Speed of sound per medium; v = fλ; string and pipe harmonics; pendulum T = 2π√(l/g); sound through Web Audio only after a tap, at a safe volume.

about.en: Temperature, conduction, convection, radiation, expansion and thermodynamics.
about.hi: ताप, चालन, संवहन, विकिरण, प्रसार और ऊष्मागतिकी।

templates.subjects: science 6–7, physics 11 (thermal properties, thermodynamics, kinetic theory), evs 4–5
templates.config: { mode: 'thermometer'|'conduction'|'convection'|'radiation'|'expansion'|'mixing'|'cycle'|'sea-breeze', materials?: ['copper','steel','glass','wood','plastic'] }
templates.notes: Conductivities ranked truly; Celsius/Fahrenheit/Kelvin conversions exact; mixing by heat balance.

about.en: Measure length, mass, volume, time and temperature with real instruments, from a scale to a vernier.
about.hi: असली उपकरणों से लंबाई, द्रव्यमान, आयतन, समय और ताप मापो, पैमाने से वर्नियर तक।

templates.subjects: maths 1–6, evs 3–5, science 6, physics 11 (units, errors, vernier, screw gauge)
templates.config: { instrument: 'scale'|'tape'|'balance'|'cylinder'|'clock'|'stopwatch'|'thermometer'|'vernier'|'screw-gauge'|'hand-span', object?: string, units?: 'cm'|'mm'|'m'|'g'|'kg'|'mL'|'L' }
templates.notes: Least count and zero error for vernier and screw gauge; real object sizes; parallax shown.

about.en: Collect data, make tables, bar graphs, pictographs, pie charts, histograms and line graphs; find mean, median and mode.
about.hi: आँकड़े इकट्ठा करो, तालिका, दंड आलेख, चित्रालेख, पाई चार्ट, आयतचित्र और रेखा ग्राफ़ बनाओ; माध्य, माध्यिका और बहुलक निकालो।

templates.subjects: maths 2–12 (data handling, statistics), economics 11 (statistics), geography 11–12 (practical work), science (experiment data)
templates.config: { chart: 'tally'|'pictograph'|'bar'|'double-bar'|'pie'|'histogram'|'line'|'scatter'|'ogive'|'frequency-polygon', data: [{ label: {en,hi} or string, value: number }] or { rows: [[x, y]] }, ask?: 'mean'|'median'|'mode'|'range'|'max'|'min'|'correlation' }
templates.notes: Statistics computed exactly; charts drawn to scale; data must be the lab's own given numbers (no invented statistics about real places presented as fact).

about.en: Jump, zoom and place numbers: counting, integers, fractions, decimals and real numbers.
about.hi: छलाँग लगाओ, ज़ूम करो और संख्याएँ रखो: गिनती, पूर्णांक, भिन्न, दशमलव और वास्तविक संख्याएँ।

templates.config: { min: number, max: number, step?: number, mode: 'count'|'add'|'subtract'|'place'|'compare'|'zoom'|'integers'|'irrational', start?: number, jumps?: [number], ask?: number or expression string like '-3+5' or 'sqrt(2)' }
templates.notes: Exact arithmetic (no float drift shown); √2 constructed by the spiral method in irrational mode.

about.en: Cut a roti or a chocolate bar into equal parts; compare, add and find equivalent fractions.
about.hi: रोटी या चॉकलेट को बराबर भागों में काटो; भिन्नों की तुलना करो, जोड़ो और तुल्य भिन्न ढूँढो।

templates.config: { object: 'roti'|'bar'|'pizza'|'jar', bars: [{ n: 1–12, k?: shaded count, lock?: boolean }] (1–2 bars), op?: 'compare'|'add'|'subtract'|'equivalent' }
templates.notes: Port the prototype (docs/family-app/mockups/netcyberai-labs/templates.js) and add pizza and jar looks and add/subtract.

about.en: Ones, tens, hundreds and thousands with blocks and an abacus; regroup to add and subtract.
about.hi: इकाई, दहाई, सैकड़ा और हज़ार ब्लॉक और गिनतारे से; जोड़ने-घटाने के लिए समूह बनाओ।

templates.config: { mode: 'build'|'abacus'|'add'|'subtract'|'expand'|'compare', target?: integer 0–99999, a?: integer, b?: integer, places?: 2–5 }
templates.notes: Indian place names (lakh appear at 6 digits if places=6).

about.en: Draw and construct with ruler, compass and protractor; angles, triangles, circles, symmetry, congruence and similarity.
about.hi: रूलर, परकार और चाँदे से बनाओ; कोण, त्रिभुज, वृत्त, सममिति, सर्वांगसमता और समरूपता।

templates.subjects: maths 1–10 (shapes, angles, triangles, quadrilaterals, circles, constructions, symmetry, transformations)
templates.config: { mode: 'identify'|'angle'|'triangle'|'quadrilateral'|'circle'|'construct'|'symmetry'|'congruence'|'similarity'|'transform'|'tangram'|'pythagoras', task?: string id from the template's list (e.g. 'bisect-angle','perpendicular-bisector','triangle-sss','tangent-from-point','divide-segment'), given?: { lengths?: [cm], angles?: [deg] } }
templates.notes: Geometry exact (measures shown to 1 decimal); constructions only with the allowed tools; theorems demonstrated, never asserted wrongly.

about.en: Turn, unfold and fill solids: nets, faces, edges, surface area and volume.
about.hi: ठोस आकार घुमाओ, खोलो और भरो: जाल, फलक, किनारे, पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और आयतन।

templates.subjects: maths 1–10 (shapes around us, nets, mensuration, surface areas and volumes), maths 12 (3D geometry)
templates.config: { solid: 'cube'|'cuboid'|'cylinder'|'cone'|'sphere'|'hemisphere'|'prism'|'pyramid'|'frustum'|'combination', dims?: { l?, b?, h?, r? } in cm, mode: 'turn'|'net'|'count'|'surface'|'volume'|'fill'|'cut' }
templates.notes: Formulas exact with π = 22/7 or 3.14 as the lab says; nets valid; three.js optional, canvas fallback required.

about.en: Balance equations, use algebra tiles, expand and factorise.
about.hi: समीकरण संतुलित करो, बीजगणित टाइलों से गुणा और गुणनखंड करो।

templates.subjects: maths 6–11 (equations, expressions, identities, polynomials, linear equations, quadratics)
templates.config: { mode: 'balance'|'tiles'|'expand'|'factorise'|'pattern'|'solve-pair', equation?: string like '3x+5=20' or '(x+2)(x+3)', unknown?: 'x' }
templates.notes: Symbolic steps checked exactly; only operations applied to both sides keep the balance.

about.en: Plot points, lines and curves; change a, b, c and see the graph move; slopes, areas and limits.
about.hi: बिंदु, रेखाएँ और वक्र बनाओ; a, b, c बदलो और ग्राफ़ को चलते देखो; ढलान, क्षेत्रफल और सीमाएँ।

templates.subjects: maths 6–12 (coordinates, linear equations, polynomials, trigonometric functions, calculus, linear programming), physics and economics graphs
templates.config: { mode: 'points'|'line'|'pair'|'quadratic'|'polynomial'|'trig'|'exp-log'|'derivative'|'integral'|'inequality'|'lp', expr?: string (a safe expression parsed by the template, no eval), params?: { a?: [min,max,start], b?, c? }, points?: [[x,y]] }
templates.notes: A small expression parser (numbers, x, + − × ÷ ^, sin cos tan, sqrt, log, ln, exp, abs, π, e); never eval.

about.en: Unit circle, ratios, heights and distances with a real clinometer.
about.hi: इकाई वृत्त, अनुपात, ऊँचाई और दूरी असली नतिमापी से।

templates.config: { mode: 'ratios'|'unit-circle'|'heights'|'identities'|'graphs', angle?: degrees, scene?: 'tower'|'tree'|'kite'|'building'|'river', ask?: 'height'|'distance'|'angle' }
templates.notes: Standard angles exact (0, 30, 45, 60, 90); identities shown numerically.

about.en: Toss coins, roll dice, spin spinners and draw cards; watch experimental probability approach the theory.
about.hi: सिक्के उछालो, पासे फेंको, चक्री घुमाओ, पत्ते निकालो; प्रायोगिक प्रायिकता को सिद्धांत के पास जाते देखो।

templates.config: { device: 'coin'|'die'|'two-dice'|'spinner'|'bag'|'cards', spinner?: [{label, weight}], bag?: [{colour, count}], ask?: string id of an event from the template's list (e.g. 'head','even','sum-7','red','ace') }
templates.notes: Fair random draws; theoretical probabilities exact fractions.

about.en: Indian coins and notes; buy, pay and get change; profit, loss, discount and interest.
about.hi: भारतीय सिक्के और नोट; ख़रीदो, भुगतान करो, बाक़ी लो; लाभ, हानि, छूट और ब्याज।

templates.config: { mode: 'count'|'pay'|'change'|'bill'|'profit-loss'|'discount'|'simple-interest'|'compound-interest'|'budget', items?: [{ name: {en,hi}, price: rupees }], budget?: rupees, rate?: percent, years?: number }
templates.notes: Current Indian denominations (₹1, 2, 5, 10, 20 coins; ₹10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 notes); arithmetic exact in paise.

about.en: Set the time, read clocks, count days, weeks and months.
about.hi: समय सेट करो, घड़ी पढ़ो, दिन, सप्ताह और महीने गिनो।

templates.config: { mode: 'read'|'set'|'elapsed'|'calendar'|'24h', time?: 'HH:MM', ask?: 'HH:MM' or a duration in minutes, month?: 1–12 }
templates.notes: Hour hand moves with minutes; real calendar month lengths.

about.en: Continue and create patterns with shapes, colours and numbers; sequences and progressions.
about.hi: आकारों, रंगों और संख्याओं से पैटर्न आगे बढ़ाओ और बनाओ; अनुक्रम और श्रेढ़ी।

templates.config: { kind: 'shapes'|'colours'|'numbers'|'ap'|'gp'|'figurate', seed: [items or numbers], rule?: string like '+3' or '×2' or 'abb', show?: integer }
templates.notes: AP and GP terms and sums exact.

about.en: Add and multiply matrices, find determinants; draw and add vectors in 2D and 3D.
about.hi: आव्यूह जोड़ो और गुणा करो, सारणिक निकालो; 2D और 3D में सदिश बनाओ और जोड़ो।

templates.config: { mode: 'matrix-add'|'matrix-multiply'|'determinant'|'inverse'|'vector-add'|'dot'|'cross'|'line-3d', a?: number[][], b?: number[][], u?: [x,y,z], v?: [x,y,z] }
templates.notes: Exact rational arithmetic.

templates.status: built in the prototype; port and extend

about.en: Sun, Earth and Moon in 3D: day and night, seasons, phases, eclipses, the solar system and stars.
about.hi: सूरज, पृथ्वी और चाँद 3D में: दिन-रात, ऋतुएँ, कलाएँ, ग्रहण, सौरमंडल और तारे।

templates.subjects: evs 3–5, science 6–8, geography 6 and 11, physics 11 (gravitation, satellites)
templates.config: { mode: 'moon-phases'|'day-night'|'seasons'|'eclipse'|'solar-system'|'constellations'|'orbits'|'satellite', startDay?: number }
templates.notes: Port the prototype; Earth's 23.5° tilt for seasons; real planet order and relative facts; three.js r128 with a 2D fallback.

about.en: Layers of the Earth, rocks, soil, volcanoes, earthquakes, the water cycle, weather and climate.
about.hi: पृथ्वी की परतें, चट्टानें, मिट्टी, ज्वालामुखी, भूकंप, जल चक्र, मौसम और जलवायु।

templates.subjects: evs 3–5, science 6–9, geography 6–12 (landforms, interior, rocks, weathering, atmosphere, water, climate)
templates.config: { mode: 'layers'|'rock-cycle'|'soil'|'volcano'|'earthquake'|'plates'|'water-cycle'|'weather'|'winds'|'monsoon'|'erosion'|'groundwater'|'atmosphere-layers', region?: 'india'|'world' }
templates.notes: Layer depths and temperatures from NCERT; monsoon winds over India in the right directions and months.

about.en: India and world maps with layers: rivers, mountains, states, climate, soils, crops, resources, industries, routes and historical places.
about.hi: भारत और विश्व के मानचित्र परतों के साथ: नदियाँ, पर्वत, राज्य, जलवायु, मिट्टी, फ़सलें, संसाधन, उद्योग, मार्ग और ऐतिहासिक स्थान।

templates.subjects: evs 3–5, social science 6–10, geography 11–12, history 6–12, economics (resources)
templates.config: { base: 'india'|'world'|'asia'|'state:<code>', layers: [layer ids from the template's list: 'states','rivers','mountains','plateaus','deserts','climate','rainfall','soils','forests','crops:<crop>','minerals:<mineral>','industries','ports','railways','national-parks','dams','historic:<period>','latitude','time-zones'], task?: 'locate'|'label'|'compare'|'route', places?: [place ids], ask?: string }
templates.notes: Map shapes from public-domain data (Natural Earth, or official Survey of India outlines); India's boundaries as officially depicted by the Government of India; no invented statistics. Bundle simplified GeoJSON inside the template.

about.en: Latitude, longitude, time zones, the Indian Standard Time, heat zones and directions.
about.hi: अक्षांश, देशांतर, समय क्षेत्र, भारतीय मानक समय, ताप कटिबंध और दिशाएँ।

templates.config: { mode: 'grid'|'time'|'zones'|'directions'|'scale', place?: string }
templates.notes: IST at 82°30′E; 15° per hour.

about.en: Place events, people and inventions in time; BCE and CE; cause and effect.
about.hi: घटनाओं, व्यक्तियों और आविष्कारों को समय में रखो; ई.पू. और ई.; कारण और परिणाम।

templates.subjects: social science 6–10 (history), history 11–12, political science 12, science (history of ideas)
templates.config: { range: [start year, end year] (negative = BCE), events: [{ id, year, label: {en,hi}, detail?: {en,hi}, image?: asset id }], task: 'order'|'place'|'cause-effect'|'compare' }
templates.notes: Years must come from the NCERT chapter; no invented dates.

about.en: Step into a situation and choose what to do: a voter, a panchayat member, a consumer, a manager, a judge.
about.hi: एक स्थिति में जाओ और तय करो क्या करना है: मतदाता, पंचायत सदस्य, उपभोक्ता, प्रबंधक, न्यायाधीश।

templates.subjects: social science 6–10 (civics, economics), political science 11–12, business studies 11–12, sociology, psychology, evs (safety, health), english (situations)
templates.config: { setting: string, role: {en,hi}, scenes: [{ id, text: {en,hi}, image?: asset id, choices: [{ id, text: {en,hi}, next: scene id or 'end', feedback: {en,hi}, good?: boolean }] }] (2–8 scenes) }
templates.notes: Branching graph validated (every next exists, every path ends); no real living politicians or parties.

about.en: Markets, demand and supply, production, costs, national income, money, banks and budgets.
about.hi: बाज़ार, माँग और आपूर्ति, उत्पादन, लागत, राष्ट्रीय आय, मुद्रा, बैंक और बजट।

templates.subjects: social science 9–10 (economics), economics 11–12, business studies 12 (financial markets)
templates.config: { mode: 'demand-supply'|'elasticity'|'costs'|'revenue'|'production'|'circular-flow'|'national-income'|'money-creation'|'multiplier'|'budget'|'exchange-rate'|'sectors'|'credit', params?: object of numbers named by the mode }
templates.notes: Textbook models exactly (linear demand and supply, cost curves, Keynesian multiplier 1/(1−MPC), money multiplier 1/rr); illustrative numbers, never presented as real data.

about.en: Journal, ledger, trial balance and final accounts: post real transactions and watch them balance.
about.hi: रोज़नामचा, खाता, तलपट और अंतिम खाते: असली लेन-देन दर्ज करो और संतुलन देखो।

templates.config: { mode: 'equation'|'journal'|'ledger'|'cash-book'|'trial-balance'|'brs'|'depreciation'|'final-accounts'|'partnership'|'shares'|'ratios'|'cash-flow', business?: string name, transactions: [{ id, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', text: {en,hi}, amount: rupees, debit?: account, credit?: account }], method?: 'slm'|'wdv' }
templates.notes: Double entry checked; debit and credit rules (modern and traditional); the accounting equation always holds; Indian formats (₹).

about.en: Run a small business: forms of organisation, management, marketing mix, finance and consumer protection.
about.hi: एक छोटा व्यवसाय चलाओ: संगठन के रूप, प्रबंधन, विपणन मिश्रण, वित्त और उपभोक्ता संरक्षण।

templates.subjects: business studies 11–12, economics (entrepreneurship), social science 10 (consumer rights)
templates.config: { mode: 'form-of-org'|'org-chart'|'planning'|'marketing-mix'|'pricing'|'break-even'|'working-capital'|'consumer'|'trade-channels', business?: { name: {en,hi}, type: string }, params?: object }
templates.notes: Break-even = fixed cost / (price − variable cost) exact.

about.en: Algorithms step by step: blocks, flowcharts, Python-like code, sorting, searching, stacks and queues.
about.hi: एल्गोरिद्म क़दम-दर-क़दम: ब्लॉक, फ़्लोचार्ट, पायथन जैसा कोड, छँटाई, खोज, स्टैक और क्यू।

templates.subjects: computer science 11–12, informatics practices 11–12, maths (algorithms), vocational
templates.config: { mode: 'blocks'|'flowchart'|'trace'|'sort'|'search'|'stack'|'queue'|'recursion'|'binary'|'boolean', algorithm?: 'bubble'|'insertion'|'selection'|'linear'|'binary', data?: [numbers], program?: [lines of a tiny safe language the template interprets: set, print, if, else, while, for, functions] }
templates.notes: Its own tiny interpreter; never eval; loop limit to stop infinite loops.

about.en: Binary numbers, AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR and truth tables; how computers store data.
about.hi: द्विआधारी संख्याएँ, AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR और सत्य सारणी; कंप्यूटर डेटा कैसे रखता है।

templates.config: { mode: 'binary'|'gates'|'truth-table'|'encoding'|'adder', gates?: ['AND','OR','NOT','NAND','NOR','XOR'], value?: integer }
templates.notes: Truth tables exact.

about.en: Tables, SQL queries, sorting, filtering and simple data analysis on a sample dataset.
about.hi: तालिकाएँ, SQL क्वेरी, छँटाई, फ़िल्टर और नमूना डेटा का सरल विश्लेषण।

templates.subjects: informatics practices 11–12, computer science 12 (databases), maths and economics (data)
templates.config: { mode: 'sql'|'sort-filter'|'group'|'join'|'spreadsheet', tables: { <name>: { columns: [string], rows: [[...]] } }, task?: { en, hi } }
templates.notes: A small SQL subset interpreted by the template (SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, JOIN); sample data invented and labelled as sample.

about.en: Prepare a slide, focus and zoom: cells, tissues, microbes, stomata and more.
about.hi: स्लाइड बनाओ, फ़ोकस करो और ज़ूम करो: कोशिकाएँ, ऊतक, सूक्ष्मजीव, रंध्र और बहुत कुछ।

templates.config: { slide: string id from the template's list ('onion-peel','cheek-cells','leaf-peel','stomata','blood-smear','amoeba','paramecium','yeast','bread-mould','pollen','root-tip','xylem','muscle','nerve','bacteria','spirogyra'), stain?: 'none'|'iodine'|'methylene-blue'|'safranin', task?: 'focus'|'identify'|'count'|'draw' }
templates.notes: Slides drawn as realistic canvas/SVG micrographs; uses asset images when the founder adds them.

about.en: Open the human body system by system and follow food, air, blood, urine and nerve signals.
about.hi: मानव शरीर को तंत्र-दर-तंत्र खोलो और भोजन, हवा, रक्त, मूत्र और तंत्रिका संकेत का रास्ता देखो।

templates.config: { system: 'skeleton'|'muscles'|'digestive'|'respiratory'|'circulatory'|'heart'|'excretory'|'nervous'|'brain'|'eye'|'ear'|'skin'|'endocrine'|'reproductive'|'teeth'|'immune', flow?: 'food'|'air'|'blood'|'urine'|'signal', task?: 'explore'|'label'|'trace'|'order' }
templates.notes: Anatomically correct positions; calm, textbook register for the reproductive system (labels and diagrams only); uses 3DM asset views when available, SVG otherwise.

about.en: Grow plants and change light, water and soil; parts of a plant, photosynthesis, transpiration and germination.
about.hi: पौधे उगाओ और प्रकाश, पानी और मिट्टी बदलो; पौधे के भाग, प्रकाश संश्लेषण, वाष्पोत्सर्जन और अंकुरण।

templates.config: { mode: 'grow'|'parts'|'photosynthesis'|'transpiration'|'germination'|'tropism'|'flower'|'seed-dispersal'|'leaf-types'|'root-types', plant?: 'bean'|'gram'|'maize'|'mustard'|'hibiscus'|'tulsi'|'mango'|'balsam', variables?: ['light','water','soil','air','temperature'] }
templates.notes: Growth responds truthfully to the variables (no light, no photosynthesis); time-lapse with a day counter.

about.en: Cross plants and animals, fill Punnett squares, count ratios; DNA, chromosomes and sex determination.
about.hi: पौधों और जंतुओं का संकरण करो, पनेट वर्ग भरो, अनुपात गिनो; डीएनए, गुणसूत्र और लिंग निर्धारण।

templates.config: { mode: 'monohybrid'|'dihybrid'|'test-cross'|'incomplete-dominance'|'blood-groups'|'sex'|'dna'|'pedigree', trait?: 'height'|'seed-shape'|'seed-colour'|'flower-colour', parents?: [genotype, genotype] }
templates.notes: Mendelian ratios exact; random offspring counts approach them.

about.en: Food chains, food webs, energy flow, cycles of matter, habitats, adaptation and waste.
about.hi: आहार शृंखला, आहार जाल, ऊर्जा प्रवाह, पदार्थों के चक्र, आवास, अनुकूलन और कचरा।

templates.config: { mode: 'chain'|'web'|'pyramid'|'cycle:<carbon|nitrogen|water|oxygen>'|'habitat'|'adaptation'|'waste'|'population', organisms?: [ids from the template's list], habitat?: 'pond'|'forest'|'desert'|'grassland'|'mountain'|'sea'|'farm' }
templates.notes: 10 per cent energy rule; organisms placed at true trophic levels; Indian species.

about.en: Change coefficients with − and +; an atom counter turns green when both sides match.
about.hi: − और + से गुणांक बदलो; दोनों तरफ़ परमाणु बराबर होने पर काउंटर हरा हो जाता है।

templates.config: { equations: [{ id, left: [formula], right: [formula], name?: {en,hi} }] (1–8) }
templates.notes: Never balances for the child; names the atom that is still off; asks for the smallest whole numbers.

about.en: Tyndall effect in a dark room, and why the sky is blue and the sunset red.
about.hi: अँधेरे कमरे में टिंडल प्रभाव, और आसमान नीला व सूर्यास्त लाल क्यों।

templates.config: { mode: 'tyndall', liquids?: [water|salt|sugar|copper-sulphate|milk|soap|starch|muddy] (2–6) } | { mode: 'sky' }
templates.notes: Particle size, not colour, decides whether the beam's path shows.

about.en: Drag cards into the right groups; every card explains itself.
about.hi: कार्डों को सही समूह में खींचो; हर कार्ड अपना कारण बताता है।

templates.config: { bins: [{ id, label: {en,hi} }] (2–5), cards: [{ id, text: {en,hi}, image?: asset id, bin: bin id, why: {en,hi} }] (4–16) }
templates.notes: Tap a card then a bin (and drag where available).

about.en: Match terms, pictures, words and meanings, causes and effects.
about.hi: शब्द, चित्र, अर्थ, कारण और परिणाम की जोड़ियाँ मिलाओ।

templates.config: { pairs: [{ id, left: {en,hi}, right: {en,hi}, why?: {en,hi}, image?: asset id }] (3–10), style?: 'lines'|'cards' }

about.en: Order steps of a process, a story, a life cycle or a procedure.
about.hi: किसी प्रक्रिया, कहानी, जीवन चक्र या विधि के चरण क्रम में लगाओ।

templates.config: { items: [{ id, text: {en,hi}, image?: asset id }] in the correct order (3–10), cyclic?: boolean }
templates.notes: Shuffle at start; cyclic accepts any rotation.

templates.status: built in the prototype; port and extend

about.en: Build words from sounds and letters in English, Hindi and Sanskrit; matras, syllables, prefixes and suffixes.
about.hi: अंग्रेज़ी, हिंदी और संस्कृत में ध्वनियों और अक्षरों से शब्द बनाओ; मात्राएँ, अक्षर, उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय।

templates.config: { mode: 'phonics'|'matra'|'syllables'|'affix'|'compound'|'sandhi'|'spelling', lang: 'en'|'hi'|'sa', words?: [{ w: string, pic?: picture id or asset id, meaning?: {en,hi} }], extra?: string, consonants?: [string], matras?: [string], examples?: { string: string }, parts?: [string] }
templates.notes: Port the prototype; add syllables, prefixes/suffixes, compound words, Sanskrit sandhi (simple svar sandhi) with true rules.

about.en: Build and change sentences: parts of speech, tenses, voice, narration, punctuation and Hindi and Sanskrit grammar.
about.hi: वाक्य बनाओ और बदलो: शब्द-भेद, काल, वाच्य, कथन, विराम चिह्न और हिंदी-संस्कृत व्याकरण।

templates.config: { mode: 'build'|'tag'|'transform'|'punctuate'|'fix'|'combine', lang: 'en'|'hi'|'sa', items: [{ id, words?: [string], sentence?: string, answer: string or [string], tags?: [string], rule: {en,hi} }] (2–8), tagset?: ['noun','pronoun','verb','adjective','adverb','preposition','conjunction','interjection','article'] or the Hindi/Sanskrit equivalents }
templates.notes: Answers are the lab's own; the template compares normalised text and shows the rule.

about.en: Listen to a short passage, see it as picture panels, find meanings, feel the rhythm and answer about it.
about.hi: एक छोटा अंश सुनो, उसे चित्र-पट्टियों में देखो, अर्थ ढूँढो, लय महसूस करो और उसके बारे में उत्तर दो।

templates.config: { mode: 'panels'|'rhythm'|'vocab'|'character'|'emotion-map'|'read-along', lang: 'en'|'hi'|'sa', passage: { title: {en,hi} or string, lines: [string] } (our own short retelling or summary, never the textbook text), words?: [{ w, meaning: {en,hi} }], characters?: [{ id, name, traits: [{en,hi}] }] }
templates.notes: Copyright: never paste textbook passages or poems; use a short original retelling and the lesson's key words.

about.en: Build a letter, notice, report, diary entry, essay or speech from its parts in the right order and format.
about.hi: पत्र, सूचना, रिपोर्ट, डायरी, निबंध या भाषण को उसके भागों से सही क्रम और प्रारूप में बनाओ।

templates.config: { kind: 'formal-letter'|'informal-letter'|'notice'|'report'|'diary'|'essay'|'speech'|'email'|'advertisement'|'invitation'|'article', lang: 'en'|'hi', parts: [{ id, text: {en,hi} or string, slot: string }] }
templates.notes: Formats follow CBSE writing conventions.

about.en: Try classic psychology experiments on yourself: memory, attention, perception, illusions and learning.
about.hi: ख़ुद पर मनोविज्ञान के प्रसिद्ध प्रयोग आज़माओ: स्मृति, ध्यान, प्रत्यक्षीकरण, भ्रम और अधिगम।

templates.config: { experiment: 'memory-span'|'serial-position'|'stroop'|'reaction-time'|'illusion:<muller-lyer|ponzo|kanizsa>'|'attention-split'|'learning-curve'|'survey', trials?: integer }
templates.notes: Results stay in the page; no personal data stored; explain that it is a demonstration, not a test of the child.

about.en: Families, communities, institutions, diversity and change, explored through cards, maps of relationships and simple surveys.
about.hi: परिवार, समुदाय, संस्थाएँ, विविधता और परिवर्तन, कार्डों, संबंधों के मानचित्र और सरल सर्वेक्षणों से।

templates.subjects: sociology 11–12, social science 6–10, evs 1–5 (family and friends)
templates.config: { mode: 'family-tree'|'web'|'institutions'|'change'|'survey'|'compare', nodes?: [{ id, label: {en,hi} }], links?: [[from, to, {en,hi}]], questions?: [{ id, q: {en,hi}, options: [{en,hi}] }] }
templates.notes: Neutral, respectful, no stereotypes; survey answers kept on the device only.

about.en: Hold an election, pass a law, see how the three organs and levels of government work, and read the Constitution's key ideas.
about.hi: चुनाव कराओ, क़ानून पास करो, सरकार के तीनों अंग और स्तर कैसे काम करते हैं देखो, और संविधान के मुख्य विचार पढ़ो।

templates.subjects: social science 6–10 (civics, democratic politics), political science 11–12
templates.config: { mode: 'election'|'law-making'|'organs'|'levels'|'rights'|'federalism'|'courts'|'panchayat'|'budget-session', options?: object }
templates.notes: Procedures as the Constitution and NCERT describe; fictional candidates and parties only.

about.en: Mix colours, make rangoli and symmetrical patterns, explore Indian art forms.
about.hi: रंग मिलाओ, रंगोली और सममित पैटर्न बनाओ, भारतीय कला रूपों को जानो।

templates.config: { mode: 'mix'|'rangoli'|'symmetry'|'art-form', art_form?: 'madhubani'|'warli'|'gond'|'kalamkari'|'pattachitra' }
templates.notes: Primary/secondary colour mixing true (paint model).

about.en: Turn a word problem into a quadratic equation by trying it: slide the unknown, watch the story's areas, products or journey times, write the equation step by step, then find the roots and see which ones the story accepts.
about.hi: स्टोरी वाले सवाल को आज़माकर द्विघात समीकरण में बदलो: अज्ञात को खिसकाओ, क्षेत्रफल, गुणनफल या सफ़र का समय देखो, समीकरण स्टेप-दर-स्टेप लिखो, फिर मूल निकालो और देखो स्टोरी कौन-सा मूल मानती है।

templates.subjects: maths 9–11 (quadratic equations, word problems, modelling; also areas, ages, consecutive numbers, speed-time)
templates.config: { situations: [{ id, kind: 'product'|'journey', title: {en,hi}, story: {en,hi}, unknown: {en,hi}, p: [c0, c1], q: [c0, c1], pName, qName, result: {en,hi}, target: number (product); distance, slower, extra (journey); min, max: whole numbers; solve?: boolean }] }
templates.notes: All arithmetic exact for whole numbers: product (p0 + p1 x)(q0 + q1 x) = target, or distance/(x - slower) - distance/x = extra. The equation is derived and reduced by the template; roots by the quadratic formula; a root that makes x, a side or a speed zero or negative is rejected, D < 0 means the story is impossible.

about.en: Choose a, b and c, then run the quadratic formula one stage at a time: read a, b, c; compute the discriminant; read what it says; get the roots and check them. A parabola drawn from computed points shows the roots on the x-axis.
about.hi: a, b और c चुनो, फिर द्विघात सूत्र को एक-एक स्टेप में चलाओ: a, b, c पढ़ो; विविक्तकर निकालो; देखो वह क्या बताता है; मूल निकालो और जाँचो। गणना किए बिंदुओं से बना परवलय मूलों को x-अक्ष पर दिखाता है।

templates.subjects: maths 10–11 (quadratic formula, discriminant, nature of roots)
templates.config: { equations: [{ id, a: -5..5 not 0, b: -12..12, c: -12..12, name?: {en,hi} }], steppers?: boolean }
templates.notes: D = b^2 - 4ac exact; perfect-square roots shown as exact fractions, others to 2 decimals; every root is put back into the equation to check; a is never 0.
